newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Perdigao still a hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Perdigao still a hold.

text.p: -- Fator Securities said in a report it was maintaining its hold rating on Brazilian food company Perdigao Alimentos.
-- It said the company reported net income of 8.8 million reais in the first quarter, a rise of 319.3 percent year-on-year and 104.1 percent above its forecast.
-- Seasonal need to buy grains for inventories should cut profitability in the second quarter, although results were likely to improve again by the third and fourth quarters, it added.
-- Perdigao preferred stock was up 0.44 percent at 2.26 reais earlier on the Sao Paulo bourse.
